svg.text: Where appointment results split into external systems and statistics
Commit one durable fact, then let each consumer rebuild the state it owns.
Solid lines are explicit record and delivery boundaries. A statistics projection is not the same thing as the current appointment aggregate; every outcome starts at a visible decision card.
